verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs list an "SSH keys" section next to its Git documentation, which shows the product documents SSH keys for Git work. The pack holds only that nav-level title, with no detail on adding keys to an account or using them to authenticate Git operations. Missing for 10: documented steps for registering a key on a user account, explicit confirmation that SSH keys authenticate Git clone/push, details on key types and management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
